author: WPB6
summary: Alpha.1-era (2026-08-11) audit of CNA's test registration, oracles, pixel/golden testing, Wine/Proton and browser verification, sanitizers, CI and the scripts/ catalogue. The verification deep dives and the Development testing pages already carry almost all of it at 009d40f5, with counts, CI scope and the one-renderer-per-configure claim corrected and every retired-renderer gate removed. Residue added: the pixel harness's own contract, the smoke orchestrator and Direct2D parallelism gate, Playwright resolution, the avatar regression floor, and the POSIX-setenv gate (which fails at 009d40f5).

concepts.text: All GoogleTest sources are globbed from module tests, renderer tests and top-level tests into one default binary, CnaTests; the audited tree had no per-module test binary.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 CnaTests is still the default corpus, but sources are grouped into OBJECT libraries with focused Cna<Group>Tests developer executables.

concepts.text: The CnaTests glob is refined by documented exclusions (standalone main() programs, probes, FFmpeg-only, networking-off, POSIX-spawn-dependent and renderer-local suites), and some filters assert themselves at configure time.
concepts.note: The exclusion list changed with the renderer curation and new platform/audio implementations; the current conditions are on the pages.

concepts.text: gtest_discover_tests runs in PRE_TEST mode (cases are listed by executing the binary at ctest time) with the repository root as working directory, because fixtures are repository-relative.

cna_register_renderer_test() collapses add_test and set_tests_properties, escapes list separators inside LABELS and ENVIRONMENT, and pins the top build directory as working directory when none is given (after a module-local registration broke a Content lookup).
Exit code 77 is the project-wide skip code (kSkipExitCode), applied in bulk at root scope and per module directory with cna_apply_skip_convention().
Claim that exactly one renderer family is composed per configure, so no build can hold two renderers' registrations.
concepts.note: False at 009d40f5: a build may compile several families (CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS) and suites are kept for every compiled family; there is still no all-renderer total.

concepts.text: Standalone example programs (*_test.cpp with their own main()) are a separate corpus from CnaTests: they are CTest registrations, not GoogleTest cases.
concepts.note: Audit: 1,169 such files; 879 at 009d40f5.

concepts.text: Many example sources are shared cross-renderer controls under modules/graphics/examples: the defect is renderer-local and the other renderers run the same public fixture as controls.
Claim that the top-level tests/ directory holds only fixtures and link probes.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 top-level tests/*.cpp form the integration group of CnaTests, beside the fixtures and probes.

concepts.text: Renderer-specific tests can disappear at three layers: source filtering, registration conditions, and the runtime display pre-flight that exits 77.
Cross-compiled trees run CnaTests through a Wine wrapper set as CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR, with an engagement-gate bypass because test listing opens no device.
Process-isolation harnesses exist for process-global state (networking, GamerServices dispatcher, audio mixer, devices shutdown order), plus inspection tools that are deliberately not tests.
A negative-compilation test registers a build of cna_strict_xna_api_leak_check as its command with WILL_FAIL, so it passes only when the build fails.
Minimal-link module probes and link-closure gates check each probe's link line against a forbidden-input pattern, for example that math links nothing but itself.
CTest labels are not uniform across families (mixed spellings, many families register most entries unlabelled), so selection commands must be checked against --print-labels.
concepts.note: The audited label list included retired families; the current guidance is on the page.

concepts.text: ctest -L input is one CTest entry, CnaInputTests, running a single canonical filter over CnaTests shuffled and repeated five times, the order-independence gate for process-wide input singletons.

The image-oracle corpus is tools/xna-oracle: 39 declarative scenes with 256x256 reference PNGs captured once from real XNA 4.0 under Wine; the C# runner is checked in, its binary, the runtime and the prefix are not and are needed only to regenerate.
One renderer-agnostic CNA oracle program (CnaOracleRender.cpp) is built into several renderer trees.
concepts.note: Audit: five builds including retired families; at 009d40f5 four trees (DIRECTX9, EasyGL, FNA3D, Software).

concepts.text: xna-diff.py compares absolute per-channel differences with Pillow, default tolerance 0, with optional split RGB/alpha bounds, a raw-difference budget and an allowed rectangle; there is no PSNR or SSIM, and its header warns that raising tolerance without a per-scene reason turns authenticity into parity.
Which oracle runners are registered CTests and what each actually fails on (a hard DIRECTX9 gate, a render-only FNA3D gate, a 2D-subset gate).
concepts.note: At 009d40f5: DIRECTX9 all 39 at tolerance 0, FNA3D render-only, Software and EasyGL two line scenes; the audited 2D-subset gate belonged to a retired family.

concepts.text: A per-scene tolerance policy table for a 2D renderer's SpriteBatch subset (seven exact scenes, two bounded linear-filter scenes) with a runner that audited policy-scene set equality.
concepts.note: The renderer family that owned the table is retired at 009d40f5; the generic lesson is kept as a separate concept.

concepts.text: Generic lesson of a per-scene policy: keep it beside the scenes, make every relaxation explicit and spatially bounded, and check that the policy's scene set equals the corpus before comparing.
A numeric oracle chain compares CNA reference dumps with a live FNA.dll (compare-fna-reference.py, one-directional, 1e-4 absolute); it is a manual tool and found the real IndexElementSize divergence.
Claim that the decompiled XNA sources and XNA specification repositories are referenced nowhere in CNA.

target.evidence: grep of CNA tests at 009d40f5; CLAUDE.md tie-break rule

concepts.note: At 009d40f5 seventeen test files cite xna4-decomp paths in comments, though no script reads it; the contributor rules make measured XNA behaviour the tie-break.

concepts.text: In-corpus oracles come in kinds: golden value tables derived from FNA arithmetic, independent recomputation ladders (glTF), and shared oracle headers so copies cannot drift.
A renderer-versus-renderer 64x64 differential excludes unstable constructs by whitelist instead of widening tolerance; its compare tool defaults to tolerance 40.
LZX decompression has a byte-exact differential against FNA's LzxDecoder.cs run under Mono, with vendored reference bytes; it found a real heap overflow.
PixelTestGame's ExpectPixel compares R, G and B only; CompareGoldenImage fails on size mismatch then compares RGB within a tolerance; CNA_UPDATE_GOLDEN rewrites the reference.
The golden images are 17 8x8 PNGs captured from EasyGL in examples/golden, compared by EasyGL sources and reused by a second family at the same tolerances.
concepts.note: The audited second consumer is retired; at 009d40f5 thirteen Vulkan registrations reuse the EasyGL goldens.

concepts.text: Golden tolerances range from 0 to 60 per channel, so the widest goldens only catch gross regressions, not shading drift.
Single-pixel checks are far broader than goldens (hundreds of ExpectPixel call sites across many families).
concepts.note: Audit 340 sites in 70 files; 225 in 49 files at 009d40f5.

concepts.text: RunPixelTest pre-flights SDL video and returns 77, turns only a VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR construction failure into a skip, rethrows everything else so real pipeline bugs crash, and runs the test exactly once in the first Draw().
concepts.note: Expansion wpb6-pixel-harness-contract.

concepts.text: The pixel harness also forces GraphicsProfile::HiDef (back-buffer readback throws under Reach), requires a 1x1 ExpectPixel rectangle because GetBackBufferData validates the element count, skips no pre-flight under CNA_EXAMPLES_NO_SDL, and offers MarkFailedEXT() for non-pixel failures.
concepts.note: TARGET-only detail found while re-verifying the audited harness facts.

concepts.text: Without a display the whole pixel and golden layer is reported SKIPPED, not FAILED, so a green ctest is no evidence that any pixel was compared.

The cross-renderer smoke orchestrator run-all-renderer-smoke-tests.sh configures missing trees, builds ignoring the build status, runs ctest -L GraphicsSmoke, reports configure failures as skipped, and is invoked by nothing.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the default set is OPENGLES3, VULKAN, SDL_RENDERER, with --tier and --multi modes; the build-status defect is Known Issues CNA-BUG-036.

concepts.text: Every Wine wrapper follows one sequence: validate arguments, choose an isolated prefix, refuse a prefix without system.reg instead of bootstrapping, run wine through tee keeping PIPESTATUS, then inspect the log.

The engagement gate is a grep of the captured log for the translator's own banner (a DXVK version line, a vkd3d-proton applicationVersion line); without it the wrapper exits 3 whatever the program returned.
Prefix map: DIRECTX9 and DIRECTX11 share ~/.wine-cna-d3d11 through separate variables, DIRECTX12 has its own, and the Direct2D launcher defaults to the developer's $HOME/.wine.
Wrappers and prefixes for DirectDraw-era, Direct3D 8 and Direct3D 10 renderers, including per-wrapper DISPLAY and device-filter workarounds.
concepts.note: Those renderer identities are retired at 009d40f5 and their wrappers are gone from scripts/.

concepts.text: Proton lanes differ from Wine: they bootstrap their own prefix, pin the Direct2D runtime from a pin file and refuse Experimental, publish runtime identity read from the shipped DXVK DLL, have no log gate, and refuse ~/.wine after a 2026-07-14 incident.

run-direct2d-virtual-display.sh is the single reentrant Xvfb decision point, and run-direct2d-fresh-wine-suite.sh proves independence from developer state with a throwaway prefix built by wineboot --init only.

The browser drivers use Playwright's headless Chromium and resolve Playwright through createRequire because ES-module resolution ignores NODE_PATH; the shell launchers set NODE_PATH to the global npm root.
concepts.note: Expansion wpb6-playwright-resolution.

concepts.text: Browser pages are served over loopback HTTP (never file://) with readiness polling, and the suite gives each page its own port (8731-8736).
The verdict is published on window (__cnaSmokeDone and result fields) because a WebAssembly module's exit code is unobservable; a [FAIL] console line or page error also fails.
Compositor pixel readback goes screenshot, decode into an in-page canvas, getImageData at chosen points with bounded RGB tolerance.
The host-integration test rewrites the HTML response with page.route() because addInitScript ran too late relative to module bootstrap, and asserts CNA refuses a host-owned DOM.
The SVG_DOM driver adds structural assertions (SVG-namespace root, hidden SDL canvas, SVG children) that prove which renderer produced the frame.
No browser test is a CTest (SDL video initialisation fails under bare node), and the SVG_DOM harness has no automated caller.
One sanitizer knob, CNA_SANITIZE, instruments the main build (vendored dependencies are configured before it); some combinations and toolchains are refused.
The sanitizer presets (devices-asan, devices-tsan, devices-ubsan) are Devices-specific and set their own flags; TSan records a pre-existing race in sharp-runtime's TimeSpan copy.
Sanitizers in CI were two legs (an ASan+UBSan input row and the devices UBSan preset), with no TSan.
concepts.note: gltf-sanitizers-ci.yml adds ASan/UBSan over glTF import; still no TSan workflow.

concepts.text: UBSan vptr carve-outs for a renderer whose pinned archives were built without RTTI.
concepts.note: The renderer family is retired at 009d40f5.

concepts.text: GPU validation is wired per family (Vulkan validation layers with tests asserting the layer is active, Direct3D debug devices with fallback, Metal validation variables, WebGPU error scopes) and must itself prove engagement.
Fuzzing was four deterministic in-corpus GoogleTest files, with no libFuzzer, AFL or OSS-Fuzz.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 libFuzzer entry points exist behind explicit options (compiled-effect, model, intermediate-format, C API), but no continuous campaign runs.

concepts.text: Property testing is one hand-rolled file over the SoundEffect content reader, with no property-testing library.
Mutation testing exists for the Direct2D renderer: seven anchored mutations whose surviving test is a failure; CI runs only the dry run.

The avatar visual check is a structural floor, not an image comparison: pinned poses under Xvfb, a speckle metric for interpenetration seams, recorded per-region ceilings, and an explicit statement that passing does not mean the avatar looks correct.
concepts.note: Expansion wpb6-avatar-regression-floor.

concepts.text: CI had eight workflows (six automatic, two manual) with a per-workflow scope table.
concepts.note: 20 workflow files and 28 jobs at 009d40f5; the current scope table is on the testing architecture page.

concepts.text: CnaTests is not built on Windows CI; the workflow attributes this to POSIX ::setenv() in test files.

target.evidence: d3d-windows-ci.yml header; scripts/check_no_posix_setenv.py; modules/graphics-ext/examples/CMakeLists.txt; Wayland sources at 009d40f5

concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the call sites were replaced by System::Environment::SetEnvironmentVariable and a gate enforces the rule; the gate itself fails on twelve Wayland-only calls (issue WPB6-i001). Expansion wpb6-posix-setenv-gate.

concepts.text: Few scripts are wired into CI, most of those sit in manual workflows, and many more are CTest commands or manual tools; the distinction between exists, registered, referenced and triggered matters.

concepts.text: Test numbers measure different populations (source files, macros, registrations, executables) that must never be added or substituted, and every number needs its definition.
Renderer identity and family counts (46 identities, 42 family directories) at the audited commit.
